setting.magic_tower.enabled.description: Turns off scanning, markers and routes together.
setting.magic_tower.radar.enabled.descri: Controls radar display; routes keep their own settings.
setting.magic_tower.radar.distanceText.d: Show distance in blocks beside markers.
setting.magic_tower.radar.arrows.descrip: Point toward targets outside the camera view.
setting.magic_tower.radar.vertical.descr: Show whether a target is above or below you.
setting.magic_tower.radar.iconScale.desc: Scale radar icons from 0.5 to 2 times their normal size.
setting.magic_tower.radar.textScale.desc: Scale the distance text from 0.5 to 2 times its normal size.
setting.magic_tower.radar.opacity.descri: Enter radar opacity as a percentage: 10% (faint) to 100% (opaque).
setting.magic_tower.radar.distance.descr: 0 means unlimited display distance. Only known targets can appear; scanning is unchanged.
setting.magic_tower.radar.hideNear.descr: Hide markers closer than this distance (0–32 blocks).
setting.magic_tower.radar.margin.descrip: Keep markers 8–100 GUI pixels away from screen edges.
setting.magic_tower.radar.verticalThresh: Show height indicators at a difference of 1–32 blocks.
setting.magic_tower.radar.color.nether.d: Choose the color of the N marker.
setting.magic_tower.radar.color.end.desc: Choose the color of the E marker.
setting.magic_tower.esp.enabled.descript: Show outlines through walls. Manual target selection is independent.
setting.magic_tower.esp.chest.descriptio: Includes copper and waxed copper chests; joined chests use one outline.
setting.magic_tower.esp.mushroom.descrip: Show outlines around tracked red mushroom blocks.
setting.magic_tower.esp.distance.descrip: Show outlines within 8–512 blocks; scanning is unchanged.
setting.magic_tower.esp.color.chest.desc: Choose the color of chest outlines.
setting.magic_tower.esp.color.mushroom.d: Choose the color of mushroom outlines.
setting.magic_tower.esp.opacity.descript: Enter outline opacity as a percentage: 10% (faint) to 100% (opaque).
setting.magic_tower.esp.width.descriptio: Set outline thickness from 1 to 5 GUI pixels.
setting.magic_tower.routes.enabled.descr: Turns off route drawing and route computation; radar and ESP remain independent.
setting.magic_tower.routes.auto.descript: Route to discovered portals only; no undiscovered portal predictions.
setting.magic_tower.routes.auto.nether.d: Allow automatic routes to discovered nether portals.
setting.magic_tower.routes.auto.end.desc: Requires the server announcement that an evacuation room appeared.
setting.magic_tower.routes.exploreDefaul: Show exploration routes on each floor
Saved preference. The Status page can override it for the current floor. Applying a changed default updates this floor too.
setting.magic_tower.routes.manual.descri: Use the target key to mark routes; Shift + that key cycles targets.
setting.magic_tower.routes.color.explore: Routes to reachable blocked bedrock boundaries. These do not predict which boundary will open.
setting.magic_tower.routes.opacity.descr: Enter route opacity as a percentage: 10% (faint) to 100% (opaque).
setting.magic_tower.hints.enabled.descri: Show target information and route hints below the crosshair.
setting.magic_tower.hints.controls.descr: Hints use your current key binding.
setting.magic_tower.hints.exploreCount.d: Show the current number of exploration routes.
setting.magic_tower.hints.priority.descr: A routing priority score, not a success probability.
setting.magic_tower.hints.messages.descr: Choose Chat, Actionbar or Off for ordinary route operation messages.
setting.magic_tower.routes.select.nether: Allow manual routes to this target type, regardless of its radar or ESP display.
Choose the color of routes to this target type.
